body: BLOCK exact 60d1827f9356b8a2cf3121e214432ef597edca70 over base e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a. Exact two-path scope and git diff --check are clean; the root-anchored /tmp/ rule is fail-closed, the court exposes no participant filename, digest, or content, and its local-sensitive/SensitiveDigest, alias quarantine, timebase, semantic-authority, and diagnostic-only boundaries are sound. One construction-level defect remains in the stated independent-axis contract. Line 37 and gate line 142 merge media-edition rights with coder-annotation rights even though ADR 0007 requires per-stream rights and the movie plan forbids rights inheritance across source assets and annotations. Line 39 merges at least annotation workbook-to-TSV, recall workbook-to-CSV, and alias-identity receipts, while lines 55 to 58 show those lineages can resolve independently. Two scientifically distinct states therefore publish identically. Required successor: split media and annotation rights; split the three derivation receipts or use an explicit per-artifact keyed ledger; retain participant authority as its own axis. Add a mutation-bearing court where annotation rights or one derivation becomes established while media rights or another derivation stays open, and repository admissibility remains NotAdmitted. No other blocker found in the assigned review focus.
